content.title: NBT Bancorp (NASDAQ:NBTB) Surprises With Q4 CY2025 Sales
content.summary: Regional banking company NBT Bancorp (NASDAQ:NBTB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 24.3% year on year to $185.1 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.05 per share was 6.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
